paragraphs: The Countertop Shop installs countertops in Enid and across NW Oklahoma, from a single bathroom vanity to a full kitchen remodel. The showroom on S 42nd Street has sinks, faucets, tile and flooring on display, so you can plan the whole room in one place.

The shop stands out on difficult jobs. One customer's kitchen had unlevel cabinets, a large galley sink and three load-bearing posts. The crew templated carefully, cut the granite around every post, braced the bar, desk and sink, and placed the seams where they are hard to spot. She called them experts who are fully equipped, experienced and do an exceptional job.

items.name: Granite countertops
items.blurb: Granite for kitchens, bars and desks, templated and installed by the shop's own crew. The crew plans seams so they are hard to spot, adds braces where a bar, desk or sink needs extra support, and brings enough hands to carry heavy slabs safely.

items.name: Kitchen islands and bath vanity tops
items.blurb: Large islands with an undermount sink, long perimeter runs and bathroom vanity tops. The shop posts finished kitchens and bathrooms on Facebook, including a white veined island on cream painted cabinets and a white top over dark rustic cabinets. Bring your measurements to compare options.

items.name: Backsplash and tile
items.blurb: Backsplash tile to finish the counters, such as stone-look subway tile behind a gas range. The showroom displays tile next to the countertop samples, so you can choose both at the same visit and see how the colors work together.

about.text: The Countertop Shop works from a showroom at 310 S 42nd Street in Enid. A customer named Tim Healy as the owner in her Google review. The business describes itself as a kitchen and bath remodeling source for NW Oklahoma, offering countertops, backsplash, sinks, cabinetry, flooring and demolition. Its own crew handles the whole countertop job, from templating to fabrication and installation. More than 2,600 people follow the shop on Facebook, where it shares finished kitchens and bathrooms and stands with neighbors after storms hit the area.

image.alt: Countertop Shop crew of five lifting a heavy granite slab into place on a kitchen bar

steps.title: Visit the showroom
steps.text: Come to 310 S 42nd St, Monday to Friday from 8:30 AM to 5 PM, to see sinks, faucets, tile and flooring.

steps.title: Design and choose
steps.text: Talk through your layout and ask all your questions. The shop has suggested ideas such as joining two bar sections into one top.

steps.title: Template
steps.text: The crew measures and templates your cabinets carefully, planning seams, supports and how the slab gets into the house.

steps.title: Fabricate and install
steps.text: Your countertops are cut to fit and installed by the crew, with schedule updates along the way. Before install day, confirm that every piece is ready.

items.name: Anne W.
items.text:
To say we are well pleased with our Countertop Shop experience would be a gross understatement. Owner Tim Healy patiently endured my endless questions, made great design suggestions such as joining the 2 sides of our bar to form a continent & gave me timely schedule updates.

From meticulous templating to flawless installation, the hardworking Countertop Shop crew expertly handled the many challenges of our job including our large galley sink & unlevel cabinets.  They precisely fabricated around the 3 load-bearing posts, installed multiple braces under the bar, desk & sink to ensure ample support, seams were strategically placed & inconspicuously joined and extra man power was on hand to safely handle the heavy granite.

We did not realize how much planning (I.e. will that big slab fit through the door), skill, special equipment and manpower is required to do this work well. The Countertop Shop are experts, fully equipped, experienced & do an exceptional job!  We are most grateful we entrusted our kitchen remodel to them & highly recommend the Countertop Shop without reservation

service_area.h2: Countertops in Enid and NW Oklahoma
service_area.text: The Countertop Shop is based at 310 S 42nd St in Enid, Oklahoma, and describes itself as a kitchen and bath source for NW Oklahoma. The kitchens and baths on its Facebook page are from Enid. If you live outside town, call (580) 234-7131 with your location and project to check scheduling, or stop by the showroom on a weekday to see sinks, faucets and tile in person.

items.q: Do you do the installation yourselves?
items.a: Yes. Reviewers describe the Countertop Shop crew handling everything from templating to fabrication and installation, including heavy granite that took several people and special equipment to set safely. Ask during your visit how scheduling works for your job and who will be on site.

One kitchen had unlevel cabinets, a large galley sink and three load-bearing posts. The crew cut the granite around each post, braced the bar, desk and sink, and placed the seams where they are hard to notice. Bring photos of your layout to the showroom.

items.q: What else do you offer besides countertops?
items.a: Backsplash tile, sinks, faucets, cabinetry, flooring and demolition. The showroom displays these together, and reviewers mention the wide selection of products and faucets. That makes it easier to plan a full kitchen or bathroom update in one place, with one team to call.

Google lists the showroom as open Monday to Friday from 8:30 AM to 5 PM, closed on Saturday and Sunday. Call (580) 234-7131 or email info@enidcountertopshop.com to ask a question or plan your visit. Bring measurements or photos of your cabinets so the team can help you compare options.

items.q: Will my whole job be installed on the same day?
items.a: That depends on the job and on every slab being ready. When you schedule, ask whether all of your pieces, such as the kitchen and a bathroom vanity, will be installed on the same day, so you can plan any time off work around it.

final_cta.text: Visit the showroom on S 42nd St or call to talk through your kitchen or bath.
